_note: A profile preset is a NAME for a pack × adapter × engine triple, so `bm-inductor workspace new <book> --profile <preset>` stamps a new workspace without touching the checkout's own binding (.bm/profile). `pack` names what the binding's pack piece is called; `pack_deps` — when present — says the workspace composes its OWN pack from these roots (authored under assets/_extends/, resolved into workspaces/<name>/assets/), so two books on one checkout do not share a score. With no `pack_deps` the workspace shares the checkout's live pack, the pre-preset shape. `crawler` is a { type, file } selection: `known` names a host in crawlers/knownsites.json, `example` names a file under crawlers/examples/, `custom` leaves the book to drop its own script into its crawl/, and `none` (or an absent block) names no crawler. The global crawlers live in crawlers/ and are referenced in place, not copied.
